newsitem.title: JAPAN: M'bishi Estate to post 14.3 bln yen loss on bonds.
newsitem.headline: M'bishi Estate to post 14.3 bln yen loss on bonds.

text.p: Mitsubishi Estate Co Ltd said on Tuesday that it would post a special loss of 14.33 billion yen in 1996/97 under a debt assumption deal on domestic straight bonds totalling 70 billion yen.

Mitsubishi Estate said in a statement that the agreement covered two sets of the company's straight bonds: a 20 billion yen bond maturing on March 27, 2001 and a 50 billion yen bond due on November 5, 2002.

A debt assumption agreement enables a company to transfer responsibility for its liabilities to another party, usually a bank, although Mitsubishi did not specify the counterparty to its debt assumption deal.
